name: guest_subst
description: Managed-code substitutions and feature switches for single-threaded, OS-less zkVM guests (ILC stage)
note: No native object: this module carries the ILC-stage inputs, for two reasons. The guest has one hart: substitutions is ILLink.Substitutions XML that stubs the thread-pool tuning and the processor queries; bflat applies it before the user's --substitution files and rejects duplicates, so users extend it and do not override it. The guest has no OS data: the features make globalization and timezones invariant, because a zkVM has no ICU data and no zoneinfo files, and a proof must not depend on them. Floating point is not a reason: soft-float arithmetic and the exact libm operations run. The checks name the one method whose floating point the IL check must not fail on: the guest has no EventSource.

il_float_allow.note: --error-on-float reports this method as a warning. Its double (Stopwatch ticks * 1e9 / Frequency) is behind areContentionEventsEnabled, which is NativeRuntimeEventSource.Log.IsEnabled(...). EventSource is off in a guest, so the JIT removes the block; a substitution cannot fold it, because the value goes through a local. Checked against the FP-free emulator.
